title: Prophecy concerning Dumah and Arabia
description: Prophecy concerning Dumah: Someone calls to the watchman from Seir, asking how far the night has gone. The watchman answers that morning is coming, but also night. Then follows the prophecy concerning Arabia: Caravans from Dedan must spend the night in the forest, and the people of Tema are urged to meet the fugitives with water and bread, for they flee from sword and bow. The Lord says that within one year all the glory of Kedar will end, and the archers, the mighty men of Kedar, will be few.
